* [https://web.archive.org/web/20070928014432/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/swallcards.pdf Complete Card List] (Decipher PDF, archive 28 September 2007) — Light Interrupt: Too Close For Comfort, Tatooine, U
|strategy=By [mailto:roddd@ucla.edu I-Ming Chen]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/tatooine/light/small/toocloseforcomfort.html</ref>

This interrupt is a great alternative to [[Put That Down]] from the Cloud City set. While it doesn't guarantee the ability to cancel a weapon from targeting one of your characters, this version is much cheaper &#150; it's free! Instead of having you use 3 Force, you make your opponent use 2 Force or they missed with their weapon.

As an added bonus, you can also use it to prevent your opponent from using tricks like [[Hit Racer]] or [[Podracer Collision]] while your Podracer attempts to take the checkered flag.

A bit excessive, but this will really frustrate your opponent when they use 2 Force and miss regardless. &gt;:)
